verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data connectivity and aggregation API (account verification, aggregation, transaction history, the Connect Widget). It does not host user-authored automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Webhook create/edit/test/delete and the automatic 24-hour aggregation are related features, not versioned automations, and nothing in the pack shows MX ships that capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
